Name: Abigail Re-Imagined
Author: ShadowFiend898
Description:
I have taken it upon myself to recolour the Sprite and Portraits of Abigail, to have different hair and a different jacket/dress.

"That is not your portrait of Abigail... I have seen it somewhere else" - That is correct, I am using the base portrait from Character Portrait Overhaul by kamirose. I feel that this is the best representation for the Abigail that I want in my game, so if you want to download the un-edited version of the portrait then use that link > https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13/?    - The Overhaul (in my opinion) makes a lot of characters look a lot better in their portraits (particularly Abby and Haley).

If there any colour errors with any of the pixels, then let me know. If it's not a major one, or can pass as a normal outline or shade then it can be left for a while, however... If its the case that "half of Abby's hair is still purple" then it should be fixed asap.

Installation:
1. It is highly recommended that you backup the original sprite and portrait of Abby, I'd never get rid of the originals at all.
2. Extract the .zip files (if need be) in a place of your choosing.
3. Remove the originals from their place in the "Characters" and "Portraits" folders... You can either back them up in another folder or delete them (probably best to do the former)
4. Place the edited portrait and sprite in the place of the originals.

Uninstallation:
1. Remove the edited files from the folders previously mentioned.
2. Replace with the original files (hopefully they wasn't deleted earlier)
3. You can either delete the edits, or save them for later use... You can even edit them yourselves if you have the know how.


This is my first mod (using the term loosely)... This was done originally for my own game, but hopefully others may enjoy it too.
